No Result View All Result Home News Politics Business Sport Football Health Entertainment Education Opinion Editorial Columns Others LeVogue Magazine Conferences National Economy Contact Us Hausa Edition Home News Politics Business Sport Football Health Entertainment Education Opinion Editorial Columns Others LeVogue Magazine Conferences National Economy Contact Us No Result View All Result No Result View All Result 2027: Aiyedatiwa to Receive Tompolo As Tinubu Support Group Moves to Ondo by LEADERSHIP News 46 seconds ago in Politics Share on WhatsApp Share on Facebook Share on X Telegram Ondo State Governor, Lucky Aiyedatiwa, is expected to receive prominent Niger Delta figure Government Oweizidei Ekpemupolo, popularly known as Tompolo, as the PBAT Door-to-Door Movement inaugurates its state structure and distributes campaign vehicles ahead of President Bola Tinubu’s 2027 re-election bid.
The event is scheduled to hold at Democracy Park, Akure, on Tuesday, October 20, 2026, at noon.
The Southwest Coordinator of the movement, Orisamoluwa Adekunle, disclosed this in a statement inviting members of the All Progressives Congress (APC), party stakeholders and Tinubu’s supporters to attend the inauguration.
Adekunle said the initiative aimed to strengthen grassroots mobilisation and expand the movement’s presence across Ondo State ahead of the presidential election.
“The inauguration symbolises our collective commitment to the vision of a prosperous and united Nigeria under the leadership of President Bola Ahmed Tinubu,” he said.
He added that the distribution of campaign vehicles and materials would support the movement’s efforts to reach voters and communicate the administration’s policies and achievements.
“The distribution of campaign vehicles and materials is a crucial step in mobilising grassroots support and ensuring that our message reaches every corner of Ondo State,” he said.
Adekunle said direct engagement with residents would form a major part of the movement’s strategy, with an emphasis on reaching eligible voters and encouraging participation in the electoral process.
He added that the inauguration would bring together party leaders and grassroots mobilisers to discuss strategies to expand the movement’s reach and coordinate its activities ahead of the 2027 election.
According to the coordinator, Tompolo’s expected reception by Aiyedatiwa would demonstrate cooperation among political stakeholders supporting Tinubu’s re-election bid.
Adekunle urged APC members and other supporters of the President to attend the event, describing it as an opportunity to demonstrate their support for his second term.
“Together, we can build a stronger, more prosperous Nigeria,” he said.
